terms.label: No action capability
terms.agent: Read-only or suggestion-only. A person performs the operative task.
terms.fallback: Inapplicable: the person is the operator.

terms.label: Assists individual actions
terms.agent: A person invokes each action explicitly. No chaining across a multi-step task.
terms.fallback: The person, continuously and by construction.

terms.label: Bounded multi-step execution with approval
terms.agent: Executes a multi-step task inside a strictly bounded envelope. A person approves every material action and is shown the specific resource affected.

terms.label: Whole task with escalation
terms.agent: Handles the whole task inside its envelope. Requests help on uncertainty or defined hazard triggers.
terms.fallback: The person, on the system's request, after a handoff. The handoff is where the risk resides.

terms.label: No contemporaneous approval
terms.agent: Operates inside a bounded envelope with no contemporaneous approval. Out-of-envelope actions are blocked in software.
terms.fallback: The system, into a defined and tested safe state, to the extent possible. A person is notified afterwards.

terms.label: Unprofiled (status, not a tier)
terms.agent: No reliability claim is available: envelope, fallback or action boundaries are unspecified.
terms.fallback: Undefined. U is a finding requiring remediation, suspension of agent workflows, or documented high risk acceptance.

modifiers.label: Data authority
modifiers.definition: Sensitivity of what the agent may access, independent of action capability. Can raise the risk of a read-only deployment materially.

modifiers.label: Reversibility profile
modifiers.definition: Whether agent action can be undone without a heavy penalty.

modifiers.label: Customer and market impact
modifiers.definition: Who is affected (internal, customer, market, regulator, counterparty) and how badly.

modifiers.label: Stack composability
modifiers.definition: Whether the tool surface is predefined in advance or dynamically assembled at runtime.

modifiers.label: Integrated-stack accountability
modifiers.definition: Who stands behind the model, harness, and infrastructure as a whole.

modifiers.label: Population scope
modifiers.definition: Range of parties the agentic system can affect.
